about: The places that still choose a person, team, goal or workspace from a <select> of everything (any list that isn't fixed by the app, such as weeks, levels or sort orders), and how many: the pickers lint fails any other, and any of these with more. Each moves to find-and-pick (src/ui/Pick.tsx) in its item: GoalWizard, GoalEdit and Data's Owner cell after the 11 Nov talk (FS1, second part); who takes over in Remove and set-up's owners with them; the Feedback inbox with the list bar on Data and Feedback (FS2, second part). Lower a count or drop a file when you do.
